title: Figure Theme Bible
description: Shared theme specification authored once per project before any figure, icon, or plot is generated. Read by figure-bible's init_theme.py/validate_theme.py, by every generator skill (ai-full-figure, transparent-icons, scientific-figure, svg-primitives, plot-styling) for palette/typography/model defaults, and by the figure-qa scripts (check_svg.py, check_raster.py) via lib/theme.py's resolve_palette() for palette compliance.

theme_id.description: Short identifier for the theme; used to label generated artifacts.

journal.description: Target venue profile. Drives the default page width and the minimum text size from lib/theme.py's JOURNAL_PROFILES.

palette.description: Hex color codes referenced by the prompt and by figure-qa palette compliance. Recommended roles: primary, accent, neutral, background, categorical. Accepts 3-, 4-, 6-, or 8-digit CSS hex codes, or 'transparent' for background.

categorical.description: Ordered list of hex colors for categorical data series.

sequential.description: Ordered list of hex colors for a sequential (low-to-high) scale.

diverging.description: Ordered list of hex colors for a diverging (two-sided) scale.

typography.description: Font family and minimum sizes shared by generators and font-size QA.

min_pt.description: Minimum text size in points for this venue.

stroke.description: Line treatment for icons and overlays.

style_tokens.description: Positive prompt fragments (e.g., 'flat 2D', 'single continuous line', 'no shading').

composition.description: Layout conventions for the generated images.

text.description: Text ladder budget: how much verbatim text the image model is allowed to render.

reference_images.description: Up to 16 file paths of canonical reference images attached to each generation for style transfer (gpt-image-2 multi-reference feature).

model_preferences.description: Per-use-case model selection and generation parameters. Values are advisory hints consumed by the generator scripts.

icons.description: Legacy per-use-case override, kept optional for backward compatibility.

figures.description: Legacy per-use-case override, kept optional for backward compatibility.

poster_text.description: Legacy per-use-case override, kept optional for backward compatibility.

bg_removal.description: auto picks pillow-threshold unless the theme calls for BiRefNet edge quality; none leaves the raw model output untouched.
